    UConn defeated third-seeded Michigan State 67-63 in a 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 thriller on March 27, 2026, advancing to the Elite Eight. Tarris Reed Jr. scored 20 points and Alex Karaban added 17, with both players hitting key free throws in the final minute to overcome a furious Spartans comeback. 
    This video shows the final minutes of the thrilling game:
    57s
    CBS Sports
    YouTube• Mar 28, 2026
    Key Details: 
    • Result: UConn 67, Michigan State 63.
    • Venue: Capital One Arena, Washington D.C..
    • Game Flow:
      UConn jumped to an early lead (25-6), but Michigan State rallied to take a 45-44 lead in the second half.
    • Top Performers: Tarris Reed Jr. (20 pts, 5 reb), Alex Karaban (17 pts, 7 reb) for UConn.
    • Next Matchup: UConn advances to play No. 1 Duke in the Elite Eight. 
    The Spartans, led by Tom Izzo, finished their season in the Sweet 16 after coming back from a 19-point deficit.
